facts.fact: Vodacom group CTO Dejan Kastelic told Business Day that Vodafone Business has broken ground in Egypt on Africa Data Centres Egypt with Elsewedy Electric and Cassava Technologies, which will use its own GPUs for internal and external users.

systems.owner: Vodafone Business, Elsewedy Electric, Cassava Technologies

facts.fact: Vodacom group CTO Dejan Kastelic told Business Day that Kenya will be the second node where Vodacom plans to build GPUs as a service.
Vodacom group CTO Dejan Kastelic told Business Day that South Africa will be the last of three large markets where Vodacom plans to install GPUs, starting small and mainly for internal use.
